changes: Compacted Project Leader's internal control flow so Consultant, Supervisor, Builder and Recovery Guardian remain distinct capabilities without mandatory administrative handoffs between ordinary covered operations.

Recovery Guardian now directly owns covered recoverable E1 diagnosis/correction/test/hygiene through RECOVERY_DIRECT_REPAIR; blind same-action retries without material basis route to RECOVERY_DIRECT_REPLAN.
Added bounded continuous hygiene semantics: CONTINUOUS_HYGIENE_ACTIVE for covered recoverable mutation cleanup and HYGIENE_REPORT_ONLY for explicit read-only/diagnostic/no-change requests.

Standing authority and Task Authorization are treated as durable envelopes for subordinate covered work while architecture/security/permission boundaries and consequential transitions retain Supervisor/transition controls.
Bounded preflight dimensions can be reused until materially stale and evidence requirements are proportional without weakening exact-state certification.
Preserved canonical access discovery, self-provisioned diagnostics, liveness, stale-CI recovery, legacy checkpoint handling, immutable transition evidence and repository hygiene protections.
Advanced Project Leader 0.6.7 to 0.6.8 and Recovery Guardian 0.5.5 to 0.5.6; only the corresponding two version literals changed in the existing version regression test.
